subject: [Invite] AI Leaders dinner @ Nvidia GTC in San Jose - 16th of March
text:
Hi [NAME],

Noticed Warner Bros are sponsoring Nvidia GTC, so imagine you might be in
San Jose for it?

My co-founder, [SENDER], is hosting a dinner in San Jose on the 17th of March
for ~20 leaders in AI and computer vision, and we'd love for you to join.

If Encord is new to you, last week we announced our Series C -  we're a
multimodal (video, image and audio) ML DataOps platform helping AI and
computer vision teams improve data quality - spanning data curation,
annotation and labelling automation.

We've booked a private dining room at BE.Steak.A, just a short walk from
the venue, from 6pm onwards - you'll be joined by execs, co-founders and
Heads of AI in the Encord network from Anthropic, Synthesia, Flawless,
Captions and more.

Would you be interested in joining? If so, I'll send over the full details.

subject: [Invite] AI Leaders Dinner in Bellevue - May 4th
text:
Hi [NAME],

On behalf of my co-founder [SENDER]
<[LINK]>,
I'd love to invite you to a small dinner we're hosting at *Ascend Prime
Steak & Sushi, in Bellevue on May 4th. *

It'll be a small group of CxOs and AI leaders working on multimodal AI and
vision language models. We'll kick things off at 6pm with a short fireside
chat exploring challenges and opportunities in building/scaling computer
vision and multimodal AI.

Will you be able to join? Happy to send over more info if you're
interested.
